changes.summary: Accept legitimate larger HTTP response headers with an explicit configurable 64 KiB default and 1 MiB maximum, preserving DNS pinning, TLS verification and body limits.
Expose a stable response-body overflow error code for safe downstream diagnostics.
Honor the all-addresses DNS lookup callback used by Node and Bun connection racing while retaining the single validated public address pin.
Expose DNS-pinned public HTTP/HTTPS transport while preserving allowlisted HTTPS egress policy
Explicitly preserve the public manifest contract instead of exposing dependency-inferred settings types
